name: Your Company
tagline: A gaming club for people who play for real
niche: Gaming club and esports arena: 240 Hz PCs, PlayStation, VR and tournaments

listing.description: A website for a gaming club, esports arena or VR park. A Riot Games-style HUD: a glitching headline, live counters, zones as cards, plans shown like loadouts with stat bars, and a tournament board.

seo.title: Your Company — gaming club and esports in Tashkent
seo.description: A gaming club in Tashkent: 60 gaming PCs with RTX cards and 240 Hz monitors, a five-seat bootcamp, PlayStation 5 and VR. Open 24/7 with tournaments every weekend.
seo.answer: Your Company is a gaming club at 60 Amir Temur Street in Tashkent, open around the clock. An hour in the main hall is 15,000 sum, VIP 25,000 sum, the five-seat bootcamp 120,000 sum an hour, and the night pass from 22:00 to 8:00 is 70,000 sum. 60 PCs with RTX 4070 and 240 Hz monitors, four PlayStation 5 consoles and a VR zone. CS2 and Dota 2 tournaments every weekend.

sections.title: Your Company
sections.subtitle: 60 gaming PCs at 240 Hz, a team bootcamp, PlayStation 5 and VR. Drop in after class or prepare for a tournament with your whole five.

sections.label: Zones
sections.title: Where to play
sections.intro: Every seat has the same gear: Logitech G Pro mouse, HyperX keyboard and a headset with mic.

items.title: Main hall
items.text: 40 PCs with RTX 4070 and 240 Hz monitors, DXRacer chairs.

items.title: VIP
items.text: 15 PCs with RTX 4080 and 360 Hz monitors in a separate quiet hall.

items.title: Bootcamp
items.text: A room for five with a coach’s desk and a screen for demo reviews.

items.title: PlayStation 5
items.text: Four sofa bays with 65″ TVs: EA FC, Mortal Kombat, Tekken.

items.title: VR zone
items.text: Meta Quest 3 with 9 m² of free space for two players.

items.name: Night pass
features: Ten hours for the price of five

items.title: Your Company Cup: CS2
items.text: Entry 250,000 sum per team; prize pool 5,000,000 sum.

items.title: Dota 2 night league
items.text: Every Friday, with points added up over the month.

sections.label: How to join
sections.title: Three steps to your first match

items.title: Book
items.text: Message us on Telegram: zone, time and how many of you. We reply within minutes.

items.title: Account
items.text: At the desk we set up a guest card where your hours and bonuses add up.

items.title: Play
items.text: Sit down and log into your Steam or Battle.net — everything is installed and up to date.

items.a: From 12 during the day; after 22:00 only 18+ with ID.

items.q: Can I bring my own mouse?
items.a: Yes, bring any gear and we will plug it in and set it up.
A bar with drinks, snacks and hot sandwiches, delivered to your seat.

items.q: How do I enter a tournament?
items.a: The captain sends the team name and roster on Telegram; the entry fee is paid at the desk before the start.

sections.label: Booking
sections.title: Claim your seat
sections.text: We hold a booking for 15 minutes. For the bootcamp or a night pass, write ahead.

business.street: 60 Amir Temur St, lower ground floor
